evals.prompt: 帮我把这篇文章里的 mermaid 图表转成图片，要商务风格
evals.expected_output: PNG images generated with fresh-business style applied to all diagrams in the markdown file
expectations: All mermaid diagrams are converted to PNG files
The fresh-business style is applied (white/light background, blue accents)
Output images are saved to the output directory
Chart types are detected automatically for each diagram

evals.prompt: Convert the flowchart in my markdown to a dark-themed image for my tech blog
evals.expected_output: PNG image with dark-tech style applied
expectations: Diagram converted to PNG format
Dark-tech style applied (dark background #1a1a2e, cyan/purple accents)
Flowchart type is detected automatically
Image width is appropriate for web display

evals.prompt: I need to put this sequence diagram in my WeChat article, can you make it 900px wide?
evals.expected_output: PNG image with 900px width optimized for WeChat Official Account
expectations: Output image width is exactly 900px
Sequence diagram is fully visible and readable
Sequence diagram type is detected automatically
PNG format suitable for WeChat

evals.prompt: Make this gantt chart look more hand-drawn and sketchy for my brainstorming session
evals.expected_output: PNG image with hand-drawn style applied
expectations: Hand-drawn style applied (warm paper background, Comic Sans MS font)
Gantt chart bars and labels are visible
Gantt chart type is detected automatically
Sketch-like appearance achieved

evals.prompt: 转换这个 mermaid 类图为 SVG 格式，我需要矢量图
evals.expected_output: SVG format output for scalable vector graphics
expectations: Output is SVG format not PNG
Class diagram structure preserved
Class diagram type is detected automatically
Vector format allows infinite scaling

evals.prompt: 把这篇 markdown 里的 mermaid 图都转成图片，并把代码块替换成图片引用
evals.expected_output: Converted markdown file with Mermaid blocks replaced by image references
expectations: A converted markdown file is generated in the output directory
Mermaid code blocks are replaced with markdown image references
Image references use filenames that resolve within the same output directory
